# /race
1. Work out the check command(s) that prove the goal "$ARGUMENTS" is met (tests, typecheck, build). Ask the user if none exist yet; a race without a real check is meaningless.
2. Ask which agents to race (default `claude,codex`), then run `forge race --goal "$ARGUMENTS" --check "<cmd>" --agents <list> --json`. Add `--setup "npm ci"` (or the repo's install command) if worktrees need dependencies.
3. Report the ranking: status, checks passed, iterations and diff size per agent. Treat `needs-review` as a warning that the agent changed what the checks measure, never as a pass.
4. Show the winner's diff (`git -C <worktree> diff <head>`) and ask before running `forge race pick`. Run `forge race clean` afterwards.
